Retrieved context (Tax Handling):
Sales tax is calculated based on the customer's billing address. Tax-exempt customers must provide a valid exemption certificate which is stored on the customer record. Tax rates are updated monthly from the tax service provider. Invoices show tax as a separate line item. International customers may be subject to VAT; the system automatically applies the reverse-charge mechanism where applicable.

Retrieved context (Payment Methods and Failures):
Accepted payment methods: credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), ACH for US customers, and wire transfer for enterprise accounts over $10,000. Card data is tokenized and never stored in plain text. Failed payments trigger an email to the customer and a notification to the account owner. Manual payment recording is performed only by Finance systems, not through this assistant.

Invoices are generated automatically 3 days before the billing date. Payment is attempted on the billing date. If payment fails, a dunning process begins with three retries over 14 days.
